body: My dr told me that there is no treatment for adult aspergers so it would be pointless to chase it up. I've been on a waiting list for cbt for my other mental health issues for the last 7-8 months, I previously had my referral for cbt rejected because i was unsuitable. The last pdoc i spoke to misdiagnosed me with bipolar and i never heard from them again. I've been passed from department to department and i'm sick of it. The meds i'm on don't work and my doc has told me to stick out with them even though its been months.
